mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG, PROVIDER, CHEER_COUNT, USER_LEVEL, INTERESTS, IS_PUBLIC, STREAK_COUNT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND PASSWORD = #{password}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DAILY_REVIEWS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AS DAILY_REVIEW_COUNT,
( SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(TOTAL_RATING), 1), 0) FROM DAILY_REVIEWS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AS AVERAGE_RATING,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} ) AS SUB_REVIEW_COUNT,
( SELECT NVL( ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN SR.IS_CERTIFIED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 , 1) , 0) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} ) AS CERTIFICATION_RATE,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SR.CATEGORY = '장소' ) AS PLACE_COUNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SR.CATEGORY = '아이템' ) AS ITEM_COUNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SR.CATEGORY = '이동수단' ) AS TRANSPORT_COUNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUB_REVIEWS SR JOIN DAILY_REVIEWS DR ON SR.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID WHERE DR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SR.CATEGORY = '콘텐츠' ) AS CONTENT_COUNT
FROM DUAL
